name: Paddle
summary: A full Merchant of Record platform built primarily for software, SaaS, subscriptions, and digital products.

pricing.headline: 5% + $0.50 per checkout transaction; custom pricing is available.
pricing.assumptions: Public pay-as-you-go checkout rate. Terms permit chargeback or pre-chargeback fees up to $20 in USD and optional Checkout Recovery costs 10% of recovered value. Other products can use custom terms.

currencySupport.presentment: Prices and charges in 33 supported payment currencies, with fixed currency prices and country overrides.
currencySupport.customerCharge: The buyer is charged in the transaction currency shown at checkout, rather than seeing an estimate for a different card charge.
currencySupport.settlement: One balance currency can be USD, EUR, GBP, AUD, or CAD; bank payouts support a wider 13-currency list.
currencySupport.buyerFx: Normally none when the card currency matches the transaction currency; the buyer's issuer can still classify a purchase as cross-border.
currencySupport.merchantFx: Payment-to-balance FX uses the mid-market rate plus a published margin: 2% for major currencies (USD/EUR/GBP), 2.5% for CZK/DKK/NOK/THB, and 3% for other currencies. A balance-to-payout mismatch can add up to 1.5%, plus possible SWIFT or bank fees.
currencySupport.moneyPath: buyer currency → balance currency → payout currency

marketExamples.path: USD charge → USD balance → USD payout
marketExamples.cost: Choose USD as the Paddle balance and payout currency. Standard transaction and payout fees remain.

marketExamples.path: EUR charge → EUR balance → EUR payout
marketExamples.cost: Choose EUR as the Paddle balance and payout currency. Standard transaction and payout fees remain.

marketExamples.path: CHF charge → EUR balance → CHF payout
marketExamples.cost: Payment-to-balance FX is mid-market plus 3% for CHF (other currencies); balance-to-CHF payout can add up to 1.5%, plus bank fees.

sellerCoverage: Software businesses are supported in most countries, subject to Paddle's unsupported-country and risk policies.
buyerCoverage: Paddle documents sales in more than 200 countries and territories, with sanctioned and unsupported locations blocked.
products: SaaS, software, subscriptions, apps, and eligible digital products; product review and prohibited-business rules apply.

features.checkout: Hosted and overlay checkout through Paddle.js.
features.subscriptions: Recurring billing, trials, upgrades, discounts, dunning, and customer portal.
features.invoicing: B2B invoicing is available, with separate public contract terms for bank-transfer invoices.
features.paymentMethods: Cards, wallets, PayPal, and supported local payment methods by market.
features.payouts: Net seller payouts on Paddle's schedule after taxes, refunds, and fees.

responsibilities.area: Indirect-tax calculation, registration, filing, and remittance
responsibilities.note: Paddle is the seller to the buyer for supported transactions.
Included in the MoR service, subject to seller cooperation and policies.
Paddle supports billing issues; the seller remains responsible for the product and customer relationship.
The seller must account for Paddle payouts and its own business taxes.

strengths: Public pay-as-you-go rate with custom enterprise terms
limitations: Restricted to approved software and digital-product models
Conditional dispute and optional recovery fees sit outside the headline rate
Migration and invoicing can require provider involvement
bestFor: Teams wanting tax and billing operations bundled
avoidIf: You sell physical goods or unsupported services
You need to remain the seller on every buyer record
